changes.removed: The trade truce has reduced an immediate source of stress, but industrial policy and export restrictions remain live constraints. Reuters reported that China might relax rare-earth export curbs for some chip companies; the conditional language matters because selective relief would not amount to a general reopening of supply. Reuters also reported that magnet restrictions risked halting Indian auto production, showing the reach of a specialised upstream bottleneck. At the same time CNBC described Xi's push to strengthen advanced manufacturing. The policy mix therefore supports strategic capacity while the economy still needs stronger consumption. Investors should not confuse success in technological self-reliance with an immediate improvement in returns on every factory investment. Concentrate on firms that can demonstrate orders and pricing rather than simply alignment with a national priority. [[n1256]] [[n1259]] [[n1318]]
changes.replacement: The trade truce has reduced an immediate source of stress, but industrial policy and export restrictions remain live constraints. Reuters reported that China might relax rare-earth export curbs for some chip companies; the conditional language matters because selective relief would not amount to a general reopening of supply. Reuters also reported that magnet restrictions risked halting Indian auto production, showing the reach of a specialised upstream bottleneck. Strategic supply and consumer demand deserve separate tests. An upstream bottleneck does not establish attractive returns on every factory investment. changes.removed: Bloomberg reported Goldman's recommendation to buy gold and oil as long-term hedges. That supports a distinct hedge allocation, not an unconditional bullish call on energy equities. Keep producer exposure underweight until supply decisions and payout coverage reinforce each other; retain flexibility to add if the commodity stabilises without rising financial strain. [[n6114]]

Keep producer exposure underweight until supply decisions and payout coverage reinforce each other; retain flexibility to add if the commodity stabilises without rising financial strain.
changes.reason: Remove same-day Bloomberg Goldman recommendation. Replace with general conditional portfolio mechanics, no measured allocation or bank recommendation.

changes.removed: CNBC reported renewed interest in credit-default swaps while questioning whether the panic was overblown. That is useful evidence of hedging demand, but protection activity alone cannot establish a systemic event. The more practical portfolio check is whether borrower stress is appearing in company accounts. Scotiabank's tariff-related increase in loan-loss reserves provides such an operating signal. It warrants close attention to vulnerable borrowers without implying that every lender or corporate issuer faces the same problem. [[n3210]] [[n2504]] Private credit also deserves underwriting rather than a search for headline yield: AFR described risky real-estate deals damaging its credibility, while the FT discussed disagreements among rating agencies. Illiquidity and differing valuation approaches can delay recognition of a problem; they do not eliminate it. Maintain liquidity sufficient to avoid selling a strong public asset simply because a private holding cannot be realised. [[n5877]] [[n5867]]

The more practical portfolio check is whether borrower stress is appearing in company accounts. Scotiabank's tariff-related increase in loan-loss reserves provides such an operating signal. changes.removed: Gold offers the crowd a simpler response to a complicated policy environment: hold something outside the corporate earnings debate. CNBC reported gold holding steady as Fed minutes highlighted inflation and recession risks, while Bloomberg described Goldman's recommendation to own gold and oil as long-term hedges. The attraction is less about predicting a single disaster than refusing to choose between the risks of weaker growth and persistent inflation. CNBC's report of wealthy investors storing more gold in Singapore adds an identifiable custody angle to that desire for resilience. [[n4618]] [[n6114]] [[n4511]]
